question: Ethambutol causes
analysis: Ethambutol is an antibiotic used primarily in the treatment of tuberculosis. One of its well-known side effects is retrobulbar neuritis, which can lead to visual disturbances, including decreased visual acuity and color blindness. This is due to its effect on the optic nerve. The other options listed, such as deafness, red urine, and peripheral neuritis, are not commonly associated with ethambutol.
